- **`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`** (`findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep`, around line 6514): the subquery was missing the `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` filter that the other purchase-order and per-rep queries use. I added it and updated the method's Javadoc to say cancelled orders are not counted.
- **`src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java`**: added a `purchaseOrder` overload that takes a status, and a `cancelledPurchaseOrdersAreNotCounted` test that reproduces the North/South example. The existing helper still creates sent orders.

Nothing is committed.
